first_cover.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / historical-scene.
Create ONE finished Bilibili episode thumbnail, EXACT 16:9 landscape canvas, preferably 2048x1152 pixels, no borders. This is the CK3 Mod《汉晋春秋》Dong Zhuo episode, title already approved: 《洛阳炙手，公卿憎我，天下讨我》.
Visual: Premium dramatic historical game key art with painterly realistic detail, late Eastern Han China. A formidable Dong Zhuo around age50, broad heavy face and powerful heavy build, black beard with subtle grey, stern unyielding eyes, authentic dark Han-period lamellar armor and a deep red cloak. His face fills the right half in a chest-up three-quarter portrait, warm fire rim light, face readable at tiny thumbnail size. Behind him: an impression of Luoyang palace roofs and walls burning in smoky red-orange dusk, distant silhouettes of military standards, no graphic violence, no extra main characters. Charcoal shadows, ivory and antique gold lettering, ember red accent; strong hierarchy and controlled detail, no messy generic AI fantasy armor, no oversized horns or Ming/Qing costumes.
Typography is essential and must be real correct simplified Chinese, EXACT text only:
Small identity label near upper left: “汉晋春秋” with a discreet “CK3 MOD” tag.
Main title on the left half in three clean strong lines:
“洛阳炙手”
“公卿憎我”
“天下讨我”
The first title line in warm antique gold; the last two large bold ivory brush-style Chinese lettering with confident readable forms and subtle shadow. Strong Bilibili mobile thumbnail legibility. Preserve every glyph exactly: 洛 阳 炙 手 / 公 卿 憎 我 / 天 下 讨 我. Do not replace 炙 with 灸. Do not replace 憎 or 卿. Do not invent any slogan or English title. Leave ample safe margins around text and portrait; all important text stays clear of bottom-right duration badge area.
Composition should feel like an actual striking Chinese strategy-game episode cover, not an informational poster. No fake game UI, no screenshots, no platform logo, no watermarks, no next-episode tease. Output one single 16:9 finished cover, not a contact sheet or mockup.

second_cover.prompt:
Create the matching 4:3 version of this Bilibili cover. Input Image1 is the approved visual reference/edit target for the same episode. Return ONE standalone finished image with a 4:3 landscape canvas, preferably exactly1600x1200 pixels (width divided by height=4/3), NOT16:9. Recompose/extend the artwork vertically instead of stretching or merely cropping the wide design.
Keep the exact same Dong Zhuo face/identity, stern expression, beard, late Han dark gold armor, crimson cloak, painterly cinematic finish, burning Luoyang setting, black/ivory/gold/ember-red palette. Preserve the episode wording, readable mobile-sized brush typography, and compact brand block. The added height should give the portrait and lettering comfortable space: Dong Zhuo occupies the right roughly half, close-up head and armored shoulders; the left carries the three large Chinese lines, without colliding with the face. Keep all twelve title glyphs visible, no truncation.
EXACT text, no additional slogans:
brand: “汉晋春秋” and small “CK3 MOD”
title in three strong lines: “洛阳炙手” / “公卿憎我” / “天下讨我”.
First title line antique gold, next two ivory. Specifically keep “炙” correct (not“灸”), and “卿”“憎”“讨” correct. Keep at least5% safety margins. Bottom-right stays free of important text for the platform duration badge. No platform logos, watermarks, frames, extra people, next-episode preview, or UI.
Only change composition/canvas to4:3. Preserve the reference’s high-impact visual identity. Deliver a single4:3 cover, no side-by-side comparison.
